erp_requests.create:
CREATE TABLE `erp_requests` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `company_name` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_person` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `expected_users` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `package_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'New',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

portal_admins.create:
CREATE TABLE `portal_admins` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tenant_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `verification_token` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_verified` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `role` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'client',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `portal_admins_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `saas_tenants` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

saas_custom_domains.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_custom_domains` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tenant_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `domain` varchar(253) NOT NULL,
  `verify_token` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `verified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_custom_domain` (`domain`),
  KEY `idx_custom_tenant` (`tenant_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

saas_email_logs.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_email_logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `invoice_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `recipient` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `cc_recipient` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `error_message` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `invoice_id` (`invoice_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `saas_email_logs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`invoice_id`) REFERENCES `saas_invoices` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

saas_exchange_rates.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_exchange_rates` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `currency_code` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `rate` decimal(15,6) NOT NULL,

  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),

columns.updated_at: timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp()

saas_identity_otps.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_identity_otps` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `admin_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `purpose` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `code_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `payload` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `expires_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `used_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,

saas_invoices.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_invoices` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tenant_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `invoice_number` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `billing_month` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `currency` varchar(10) DEFAULT 'USD',
  `exchange_rate` decimal(16,8) DEFAULT 1.00000000,
  `source` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'MARKET',
  `due_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('Pending','Paid','Overdue','Cancelled') DEFAULT 'Pending',
  `email_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'Pending',
  `last_sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_invoice_number` (`invoice_number`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `saas_invoices_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `saas_tenants` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

saas_packages.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_packages` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `product_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `package_key` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `monthly_price` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `yearly_price` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `modules` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`modules`)),
  `services` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`services`)),
  `server_info` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_users` int(11) DEFAULT 10,
  `max_locations` int(11) DEFAULT 1,
  `is_public` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `custom_domain` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_pkg_product` (`product_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

columns.name: varchar(100) NOT NULL
columns.modules: longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`modules`))
columns.services: longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`services`))

saas_payments.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_payments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `invoice_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `receipt_number` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `payment_method` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'Bank Transfer',
  `transaction_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `receipt_number` (`receipt_number`),
  KEY `invoice_id` (`invoice_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `saas_payments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`invoice_id`) REFERENCES `saas_invoices` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

saas_products.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_products` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `product_key` varchar(50) NOT NULL,

columns.updated_at: timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp()

CREATE TABLE `saas_settings` (
  `setting_key` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `setting_value` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),

columns.updated_at: timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp()

saas_tenants.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_tenants` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `address` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `business_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `admin_email` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_number` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `billing_cc_email` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `package_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `currency` varchar(10) DEFAULT 'USD',
  `billing_cycle` enum('monthly','yearly') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly',
  `db_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT 'repair_management_db',
  `api_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('Active','Trial','Suspended','Deleted') DEFAULT 'Trial',
  `trial_expiry` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `license_key` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_key` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `deployment` enum('dedicated','shared') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dedicated',
  `provision_status` enum('none','pending','ready','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
  `provision_error` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `workspace_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `customer_type` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'company',
  `nic_br_number` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_person_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `terms_accepted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `usage_users` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `usage_locations` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `usage_updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `address_changed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `dev_mode` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `slug` (`slug`),
  KEY `package_id` (`package_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `saas_tenants_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`package_id`) REFERENCES `saas_packages` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

saas_webhook_events.create:
CREATE TABLE `saas_webhook_events` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `event_type` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `payload` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','sending','sent','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `attempts` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `next_attempt_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_http_code` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `response` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_whe_event` (`event_id`),
  KEY `idx_whe_due` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`),
  KEY `idx_whe_tenant` (`tenant_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

columns.updated_at: timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp()
